description: An HS256 JWS whose protected header is {"alg":"HS256","alg":"HS256"} (alg twice, same value), MAC correct (HMAC computed with Python hmac/hashlib under the RFC 7515 A.1 key): the JSON layer rejects the duplicate before header parsing (RFC 7515 §4, RFC 7493 §2.3; amends ADR 0026 §2 step 4)
